WHAT THE SERVICE COVERS

How this advisory service is delivered.

Every step is structured around clear deliverables, verified information, and transparent status reporting.

01 / AUDIT & ICP

Account Targeting & Qualification

Definition of your Ideal Customer Profile (revenue, employee size, product categories) and curation of 60-100 vetted target firms.

02 / MULTI-TOUCH

Executive Outreach Campaign

Personalized multi-touch communication directed to procurement heads, commercial directors, and executive leadership.

03 / HANDOVER

Qualified Opportunity Booking

Live tracking of responses, logging commercial objections, and scheduling direct handover discussions for interested buyers.

PRACTICAL DELIVERABLES

Actionable materials you receive

Throughout the engagement, we deliver structured documentation and data your team can immediately deploy.

Core deliverables
  1. 01Master Prospect Matrix: Complete database of 60-100 verified accounts with company details, decision-maker names, and direct business contacts.
  2. 02Live Communication Pipeline: Detailed log classifying every company through Identified, Reviewed, Contacted, and Responded stages.
  3. 03Commercial Handover Briefs: Structured dossiers on responding accounts detailing specific product interest, delivery expectations, and next steps.
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Good to clarify before starting

What response rate should we expect?

B2B response rates generally range between 4% and 15% depending on offer competitiveness, pricing, and sector maturity.

Who attends the commercial meetings?

Your internal commercial team leads the substantive sales discussions; we provide the introduction dossier and background context.

What payment terms apply?

For fixed-scope sprints like Market Assessment, fees are invoiced upon project kick-off. Phased sprints operate with milestone-based payment structures.
